compares: facts/vecops.json (the C outputs, f32 paths) against the equations in f64
invocation: uv run --with numpy python scripts/vecops-check.py facts/vecops.json --write facts/vecops-witness.json

ops.note: the C kernel's own inv_freq expression, in f64

note: A witness for the arithmetic, not for the conventions: the RoPE row re-implements the half-split pairing because that is what the C kernel claims to do. A wrong pairing in both would agree perfectly - which is why the pairing itself is tested against a golden vector from a known engine, not against this file.
